title: Annotation API v2 NEL request
description: Request body of POST /api/v2/entities/nel/. The same body as /api/nel/: the text and its entities, or the `[START] … [END]` marker form. The request entities may use the v1 or the v2 confidence names (`entity_confidence` or `confidence_ner_entity`, `type_confidence` or `confidence_ner_type`).
